title: GDS-ParT-MoE: per-particle Mixture-of-Experts for physics interpretability of the Gated Dual-Stream Particle Transformer
description:
GDS-ParT-MoE adds a per-particle Mixture-of-Experts to the Gated Dual-Stream Particle Transformer (GDS-ParT) for jet tagging on JetClass. In every transformer block the particle feed-forward network is replaced by a router and 8 expert FFNs; each real jet constituent is routed to its top-2 experts with renormalised weights, trained with a Switch load-balancing loss and a router z-loss. The model is built by sparse upcycling from a trained dense GDS-ParT checkpoint, so the untrained MoE reproduces the dense model exactly. An analysis toolkit relates routing decisions to particle physics (species, charge, momentum share, angle to the jet axis, impact parameter, Lund-plane kT) through routing statistics, normalised mutual information and expert knockout. In a first, preliminary run (one epoch on 300k jets) the upcycled model keeps 84.7% validation accuracy and its first-layer router partitions particles by charge and species, with one expert specialising in muons and displaced tracks.

Documentation: avinashistoocool.github.io/GDS-parT-MoE
